ble_record.label: release-ble-cap1-01

BL50_counter_window.scope: first through last observed BL50 only; includes neither all messages before first nor messages after last; driver counters are not receiver acknowledgements

limitations: The capture began with 3 CAP8 frames in revisions88/89, followed by 9128 CAP1 frames in revision90; retain these groups.
Control identity success does not establish analog precision.
BLE received-frame rate is measured separately from acquisition rate; compare parallel Serial SF50/BL50 on matching time intervals.
Backend MTU23 is not treated as the negotiated MTU; firmware reported247 and actual maximum notification payload is retained.
